## Data Profile SQL

```sql
SELECT
  customers.name AS "customers.name",
  customers.city AS "customers.city",
  COUNT(*) AS "customers._count",
  CAST(AVG(customers.region_id) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.region_id_avg",
  COUNT(DISTINCT customers.tier) AS "customers.tier_count_distinct",
  CAST(AVG(customers.credit) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.credit_avg",
  CAST(AVG(customers.discount) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.discount_avg",
  COUNT(customers.tags) AS "customers.tags_count"
FROM customers AS customers
GROUP BY
  customers.name,
  customers.city
ORDER BY
  "customers.name" ASC,
  "customers.city" ASC
LIMIT 5
```

  "sql": "WITH _base AS (\n  SELECT\n    customers__regions.name AS \"orders.customers.regions.name\",\n    customers.city AS \"orders.customers.city\",\n    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS \"orders.revenue\"\n  FROM orders AS orders\n  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers\n    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id\n  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions\n    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id\n  GROUP BY\n    customers__regions.name,\n    customers.city\n), _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name AS (\n  SELECT\n    customers__regions.name AS \"orders.customers.regions.name\",\n    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS \"orders.amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name\"\n  FROM orders AS orders\n  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers\n    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id\n  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions\n    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id\n  GROUP BY\n    customers__regions.name\n), _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by AS (\n  SELECT\n    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS \"orders.amount_sum_partition_by\"\n  FROM orders AS orders\n)\nSELECT\n  _base.\"orders.customers.regions.name\",\n  _base.\"orders.customers.city\",\n  _base.\"orders.revenue\",\n  _base.\"orders.revenue\" / NULLIF(\n    _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name.\"orders.amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name\",\n    0\n  ) AS \"orders.share_of_region\",\n  _base.\"orders.revenue\" / NULLIF(_cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by.\"orders.amount_sum_partition_by\", 0) AS \"orders.share_of_total\"\nFROM _base\nLEFT JOIN _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name\n  ON _base.\"orders.customers.regions.name\" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name.\"orders.customers.regions.name\"\nCROSS JOIN _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by\nORDER BY\n  _base.\"orders.customers.regions.name\" ASC,\n  _base.\"orders.customers.city\" ASC\nLIMIT 201"

args.message: Here is each region and city's share of revenue (revenue = sum of order amounts), as a fraction of its region and of all revenue. There are 12 groups. Customers with no known region are grouped under a null region: Paris customers make up 56.8% of that group's revenue, and orders with no known region or city make up the other 43.2%.
